measurements.name: selected_wavelength_um
measurements.reference_source: slot scale 385.2 µm; linear argmax σ is the prediction
measurements.method: radial FFT peak of the saturated activator on the 8-wavelength periodic patch

measurements.name: murray_band_center_wavelength_um
measurements.method: k_Delta^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v); above onset this is shorter than argmax σ

measurements.name: wavelength_sweep_pearson_r
measurements.reference_source: perfect agreement between linear theory and the nonlinear FFT
measurements.method: Pearson r of predicted vs measured wavelength across 8 diffusivity scales; RMSE reported separately

measurements.name: wavelength_sweep_rmse_um
measurements.method: RMSE between linear-theory wavelength and nonlinear FFT wavelength

measurements.name: ablation_control_sigma_max
measurements.method: equal-diffusion negative control D_v = D_u; max_k σ(k) must be negative

measurements.name: ablation_control_std_ratio
measurements.reference_source: no growth and no decay of the activator standard deviation
measurements.method: nonlinear ablation control: final/initial std of u with D_v = D_u, seed 3104

measurements.name: specimen_structure_tensor_coherency
measurements.reference_source: coherency of the rendered activator field (not the photograph)
measurements.method: structure-tensor coherency on the Lundgren et al. 2013 colony photograph

measurements.name: specimen_foreground_fraction
measurements.reference_source: foreground fraction of the rendered activator field
measurements.method: border-contrast segmentation of the colony photograph, same rule as verify_image_fitness

measurements.name: log10_length_m
measurements.method: log10 of the assigned wavelength 3.852e-4 m

measurements.name: specimen_orientation_ks
measurements.method: KS distance between specimen and gauge-fixed render orientation histograms
